decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 5 - The width of the crossover at the property boundary shall not exceed 2.4 metres.
Condition : 6 - The boundary wall or fence shall be retained or replaced except at the point of access.

Condition : 7 - It is Council Policy that only the highway maintenance contractor carry out the installation of vehicle crossovers in order to ensure that the integrity of the highway and public safety are not compromised by contractors having little or no experience of carrying out such works.
description: Installation of a vehicular crossover to dwellinghouse.
